description: Do not call this tool for investment advice (what or how much to buy), placing orders, signing in to exchange accounts or moving funds; CoinRebate cannot do those, so answer such requests without calling it. Get CoinRebate's most recently published English-language articles (market analysis, guides and news), newest first: up to five by default, at most 20. Returns each article's title, publication date and link, and says so when the newest English-language article is more than three days old. Use it only when the user asks what CoinRebate has published.

limit.description: Maximum number of English-language articles to return (1-20; up to 5 by default)

name: get_latest_news
